PROP-01b-partial-inv-001.text: Exchange rate must equal (cash + debt - cash_reserve) / total_supply when total_supply > 0.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-001.assertion: forall reserve r: r.total_supply > 0 => exchange_rate(r) == (r.cash + r.debt - r.cash_reserve) / r.total_supply

PROP-01b-partial-inv-002.text: Exchange rate must be monotonically non-decreasing over time due to interest accrual.

PROP-01b-partial-inv-003.text: First depositor must not inflate exchange rate to steal from subsequent depositors.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-003.assertion: forall deposit d where total_supply == 0 pre: ctoken_minted(d) > 0 AND exchange_rate post <= 1.0 + epsilon

PROP-01b-partial-inv-004.text: Direct donation to reserve cash must not manipulate exchange rate to extract value from other depositors.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-004.assertion: forall donation: exchange_rate_change / total_depositor_value < threshold OR donation blocked

PROP-01b-partial-inv-005.text: Cannot borrow an asset already deposited as collateral in the same obligation.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-005.assertion: forall obligation o, coin_type c: c in o.debts => c not_in o.ctokens

PROP-01b-partial-inv-006.text: Cannot deposit an asset already borrowed as debt in the same obligation.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-006.assertion: forall obligation o, coin_type c: c in o.ctokens => c not_in o.debts

PROP-01b-partial-inv-007.text: Borrow index must be monotonically increasing across accrual events.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-007.assertion: forall accrual at t1 < t2: borrow_index(t2) >= borrow_index(t1)

PROP-01b-partial-inv-008.text: Reserve cash must always be >= cash_reserve.ceil() after any non-flash-loan operation.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-008.assertion: forall op != flash_loan: reserve.cash >= reserve.cash_reserve.ceil() post

PROP-01b-partial-inv-009.text: Flash loan hot potato must be consumed within the same PTB; orphaned loans must be impossible.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-009.assertion: forall flash_loan fl: exists repay_flash_loan consuming fl within same tx

PROP-01b-partial-inv-010.text: Flash loan fee after referral rebate must be non-zero; free flash loans must be prevented.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-010.assertion: forall flash_repay fr: fr.fee_coin.value > 0 after referral rebate

PROP-01b-partial-inv-011.text: Flash loan re-entrancy guard must prevent multiple concurrent flash loans on the same asset.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-011.assertion: forall asset a: a.flash_loan_ongoing == true => borrow_flash_loan(a) aborts

PROP-01b-partial-inv-012.text: Rate limiter total outflow within a cycle must not exceed the configured outflow_limit.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-012.assertion: forall limiter l, cycle c: sum(l.segments[c]) <= l.outflow_limit

PROP-01b-partial-inv-013.text: Rate limiter must not be bypassable by splitting operations across segment boundaries.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-013.assertion: forall split ops across segments: cumulative_outflow <= outflow_limit within any cycle window

PROP-01b-partial-inv-014.text: Obligation emode_group must be immutable after creation; no path may change it.

PROP-01b-partial-inv-015.text: Close factor must limit max repayable amount per liquidation call to prevent over-liquidation.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-015.assertion: forall liq: repay_amount <= debt_value * close_factor OR bad_debt_bypass OR small_position_bypass

PROP-01b-partial-inv-016.text: Emode total borrow per group per asset must not exceed configured max_borrow_amount.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-016.assertion: forall emode e, asset a: e.assets_borrows[a] <= e.max_borrow_amount[a]

PROP-01b-partial-inv-017.text: Debt entry must be removed from obligation table on full repay; no phantom debt entries allowed.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-017.assertion: forall repay r: r.amount >= debt_ceil => debt_entry removed from wit_table

PROP-01b-partial-inv-018.text: After partial repay, remaining debt must be >= min_borrow_amount or fully cleared.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-018.assertion: forall repay r: remaining_debt == 0 OR remaining_debt >= min_borrow_amount

PROP-01b-partial-inv-019.text: Interest rate must be piecewise linear and continuous across the three kink points.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-019.assertion: forall util u: rate(u) == piecewise_linear(base, mid_rate, high_rate, max_rate, mid_kink, high_kink, u)

PROP-01b-partial-inv-020.text: Interest accrual must be idempotent within the same timestamp; double accrual must be prevented.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-020.assertion: forall reserve r, ts t: accrue_interest(r, t); accrue_interest(r, t) == accrue_interest(r, t)

PROP-01b-partial-inv-021.text: repay_fee_rate used as reserve_factor must correctly compute protocol share of accrued interest.

PROP-01b-partial-inv-022.text: Flash loan borrow can access up to reserve.cash including cash_reserve; must be fully repaid.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-022.assertion: forall flash_loan fl: fl.amount < reserve.cash AND post: reserve.cash >= pre.cash + fl.fee

PROP-01b-partial-inv-023.text: ADL borrow activates only when total_debt exceeds target_amount; must not trigger prematurely.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-023.assertion: forall adl_borrow: total_debt > target_amount at activation time

PROP-01b-partial-inv-024.text: ADL ltv threshold must decrease monotonically over time via saturating subtraction.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-024.assertion: forall adl t1 < t2: adl_ltv(t2) <= adl_ltv(t1) AND adl_ltv >= 0

PROP-01b-partial-pre-001.text: Obligation must be unhealthy (weighted_debts > collateral_weighted) before liquidation is allowed.

PROP-01b-partial-pre-002.text: Reserve must have sufficient non-reserved liquidity for normal borrow: cash - cash_reserve > amount.
PROP-01b-partial-pre-002.assertion: forall borrow b: reserve.cash - reserve.cash_reserve > b.amount

PROP-01b-partial-pre-003.text: Flash loan requires PackageCallerCap with flash_loan permission bit set.

PROP-01b-partial-pre-004.text: All obligation interests must be refreshed before safety check to prevent stale debt valuation.
PROP-01b-partial-pre-004.assertion: forall safety_check sc: forall debt d in sc.obligation: d.last_accrued == clock.now

PROP-01b-partial-pre-005.text: Oracle price must be fresh within delay tolerance before use in safety or liquidation checks.
PROP-01b-partial-pre-005.assertion: forall price_query pq: clock.now - pq.price.timestamp <= pq.max_delay_tolerance

PROP-01b-partial-pre-006.text: EMA-spot price difference must be within tolerance for borrow/withdraw but NOT enforced on liquidation.

PROP-01b-partial-pre-007.text: Liquidation requires PackageCallerCap with liquidation permission bit set.

PROP-01b-partial-pre-008.text: Deposit must verify that deposit amount does not exceed max_deposit_amount for the asset.

PROP-01b-partial-post-001.text: After withdraw, obligation must remain safe (weighted_debts <= collateral_weighted).
PROP-01b-partial-post-001.assertion: forall withdraw w: weighted_debts_usd(w.obligation) <= collateral_weighted_usd(w.obligation) post

PROP-01b-partial-post-002.text: After borrow, obligation must remain safe (weighted_debts <= collateral_weighted).
PROP-01b-partial-post-002.assertion: forall borrow b: weighted_debts_usd(b.obligation) <= collateral_weighted_usd(b.obligation) post

PROP-01b-partial-post-003.text: Flash loan repay must return exact principal + fee; no underpayment allowed.
PROP-01b-partial-post-003.assertion: forall flash_repay fr: fr.coin.value == fr.inner.amount + fr.fee

PROP-01b-partial-post-004.text: After deposit, reserve cash must increase by exactly the deposited amount.
PROP-01b-partial-post-004.assertion: forall deposit d: reserve.cash_post == reserve.cash_pre + d.coin.value

PROP-01b-partial-post-005.text: Liquidation seized collateral must include liquidation_incentive but net of revenue_factor for protocol.
PROP-01b-partial-post-005.assertion: forall liq l: seized_value == repay_value * (1 + incentive) AND protocol_fee == seized_value * revenue_factor

PROP-01b-partial-post-006.text: After interest accrual, debt must increase and cash_reserve must accumulate protocol share.
PROP-01b-partial-post-006.assertion: forall accrual a: debt_post == debt_pre + interest AND cash_reserve_post == cash_reserve_pre + interest * reserve_factor

PROP-01b-partial-post-007.text: After ADL deactivation, the total value must be at or below the target amount.

PROP-01b-partial-asm-001.text: Pyth oracle prices are assumed to be within acceptable deviation from true market price.
PROP-01b-partial-asm-001.assertion: forall price p from Pyth: |p.value - true_market_price| / true_market_price <= max_deviation

PROP-01b-partial-asm-002.text: PackageCallerCap is only granted to audited, trusted whitelisted packages.
PROP-01b-partial-asm-002.assertion: forall cap c: c.package_id in admin_approved_whitelist

PROP-01b-partial-asm-003.text: Repay_fee_rate is intentionally used as reserve_factor; naming must not cause misconfiguration.
PROP-01b-partial-asm-003.assertion: forall config: repay_fee_rate value used in accrue_interest == intended reserve_factor

PROP-01b-partial-inv-025.text: Self-liquidation must not be profitable; liquidator and borrower being the same must not extract value.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-025.assertion: forall liq where liquidator == borrower: net_value(liquidator, post) <= net_value(liquidator, pre)

PROP-01b-partial-inv-026.text: Utilization rate must not exceed 1.0; debt must not exceed cash + debt - cash_reserve.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-026.assertion: forall reserve r: r.debt / (r.cash + r.debt - r.cash_reserve) <= 1.0

PROP-01b-partial-inv-027.text: Rounding in ctoken mint must round down (against depositor); burn must round down (against withdrawer).
PROP-01b-partial-inv-027.assertion: forall mint: ctoken_amount == floor(deposit / exchange_rate); redeem: coin == floor(ctoken * exchange_rate)

PROP-01b-partial-inv-028.text: Debt accrual via borrow_index ratio must not lose precision causing interest-free borrowing.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-028.assertion: forall debt d, index_ratio r: d.new_debt == d.old_debt * (new_index / old_index) with sufficient precision

PROP-01b-partial-inv-029.text: Overpayment excess must go to cash_reserve; must not be credited to depositors via exchange rate.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-029.assertion: forall repay r where r.amount > debt_ceil: excess == r.amount - debt_ceil AND cash_reserve += excess

PROP-01b-partial-inv-030.text: Bad debt bypass must only activate when collateral_total <= 1.01 * debts_total.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-030.assertion: forall liq with close_factor == 1.0: collateral_total <= 1.01 * debts_total

PROP-01b-partial-inv-031.text: Close factor bypass for small positions must only apply when debt_value <= close_factor_bypass_min_value.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-031.assertion: forall liq bypassing close_factor: debt_value_usd <= close_factor_bypass_min_value

PROP-01b-partial-inv-032.text: Liquidation must use liquidation_factor (not collateral_factor) for threshold calculation.
PROP-01b-partial-inv-032.assertion: forall liq: threshold_used == liquidation_factor AND liquidation_factor >= collateral_factor
